description: This file defines the Memcached class within the Opencart system, providing a wrapper around the PHP Memcached extension for caching purposes. It includes methods for getting, setting, and deleting cache entries with specified expiration times.

classes.name: Memcached
classes.description: A wrapper class around PHP's Memcached extension to facilitate cache operations within the Opencart framework.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Memcached object, sets the expiration time, and connects to the Memcached server.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a cached value by key.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Stores a value in cache with an optional expiration time.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Removes a cache entry by key.
